test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) OV-XP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1cbc6ac51a54743b7302795b3673f734b533d22abf68f26c07e3e4621fece0.png] 

Option 2) DI-PW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa90dcd6bb609f08dc28b1a8e40f2763aa9ed13f05c92dc1829c8d8d10a5f66a.png] 

Option 3) NU-WO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d87dfd41c1ec7e0f97c41cc71f9cf0d158b3bfe8adeb84581ee6d2b290859b0b.png] 

Option 4) RY-AS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f07ddb062fae251d2bf6ef1a9eee5848ee07c01136d1dfe36b930bb78f57055.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'DI-PW' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
